root_causes.cause: ONSure consumed one aggregate adversarial script result without proving the required scenario set or dedicated execution commands.
root_causes.correction: Require an ONSURE_LEARNED_VALIDATION_PACK with required_scenarios mapped to distinct executable Fixture IDs and commands.

root_causes.cause: ONGuard tests covered named examples rather than separator, case and prompt phrase mutation families.
root_causes.correction: Add independent learned scenarios for identifier separators, case normalization and English/Korean prompt-injection variants.

root_causes.cause: Receipt verification recalculated the decision hash without actor_id, target and policy_version.
root_causes.correction: Bind all three fields into issuance and read-back verification.

root_causes.cause: Missing targets silently defaulted to external-llm and equal-priority conflicting effects were resolved lexicographically.
root_causes.correction: Reject omitted target scopes and return fail-closed UNKNOWN for conflicting top-priority effects.

root_causes.cause: Immutable references were recorded but not verified; Fixture Evidence IDs and execution configuration were not fully bound.
root_causes.correction: Verify sha256 tree or clean git commit references and bind deterministic Evidence ID, timeout and environment digest.

root_causes.cause: Fixture processes received host HOME, symlink scripts could escape the target root, and the manifest claimed unenforced network isolation.
root_causes.correction: Remove HOME, reject symlink scripts, and mark network isolation as HOST_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED with reviewed-local-only trust.

root_causes.cause: ONSure CLI returned exit code zero even when the validation report decision was FAIL.
root_causes.correction: Bind PASS to exit 0 and validation FAIL to exit 2.
